script: Let's create a secure account. Use a work email, and a password manager for a long, unique password. Go to canva.com, click Sign up, and choose Google, Apple or email. Confirm your email. You do not need a card to use the free plan. Then open Settings and turn on two-step verification. Remember: never enter card details from a link someone else sent you.
